Package org.yuemi.mmoaccessories.api.storage

Interface AccessoryStorage

public interface AccessoryStorage
Pluggable storage backend for accessory data. Implementations can store accessory data in different ways (PDC, SQLite, MySQL, MongoDB, etc.) by implementing this interface.

      plugin - the plugin instance
      config - the plugin's FileConfiguration

    • loadAccessories

      @NotNull @NotNull List<String> loadAccessories(UUID playerUuid)
      Load the list of equipped item IDs for a player. The list is in slot order (index = slot position). Returns an empty list if the player has no saved accessories.
      Parameters:
      playerUuid - the player's UUID
      Returns:
      the list of item IDs (in slot order), empty if none
